statement: For every L, the support ortholattice of M(L) is completely isomorphic to the quotient ortholattice Q+(S(L)); trace and finite-piece extension are explicit.
notes: Arbitrary L, including empty, infinite, disconnected and unbounded.

statement: Every finite conditional lattice P has an orthomodular proper-quotient logic.
depends_on: Jenca2022 Theorem4.10(a implies b),p10; Theorem3.3,p5; trace-block proof
notes: Adjoin bounds only to apply the bounded theorem; all induced-subspace and ray steps proved.

statement: For finite L, Sigma_M(L) is orthomodular iff every upper-bounded pair has a join and every lower-bounded pair has a meet.
notes: Exact all-cardinality finite characterization; no boundedness or connectedness assumed.

statement: Jenca arXiv2206.08113v1 Corollary4.5 fails as printed for arbitrary unbounded posets; it holds with boundedness retained.
depends_on: two disjoint two-element chains; bounded separating-quotient proof
notes: Full finite example checked; repaired bounded formula proved directly.

statement: For every poset L, the interval relations satisfy strong Mag1-4; full figures are endpoint-closed positional chains; faithfulness is equivalent to L being a chain.
notes: Complete order, factorization, exchange, heredity and three-stratum verification; no finiteness or density assumption.

statement: The lieux of M(L) are exactly its point symbols; every lieu support is an atom iff L is an antichain or has no isolated points.
depends_on: SA21-A05a; SA21-A06; full-refinement definition of lieux
notes: Covers arbitrary and disconnected L; rho-only minima are not lieux. All51 natural orders through4 checked.
